concerns.text: FR-004 (LOSO as primary validation) is missing a dedicated task. The Spec mandates LOSO as the primary method, but Plan Phase 1 designates Stratified 5-Fold as Primary and LOSO as Secondary. Tasks T020A/B implement LOSO as primary, creating a contradiction. A task explicitly implementing Stratified 5-Fold CV (Plan Primary) is missing to satisfy the Plan's validation strategy.

SC-003 (LOSO R² SD) is missing a dedicated task. While T020C calculates SD, it is labeled as a calculation step dependent on T020B. The Plan Phase 1 explicitly lists 'LOSO R² SD' as a required output metric. T020C exists but is buried in the sequential chain; ensure it is explicitly tagged [SC-003] to confirm coverage.

SC-005 (Execution time < 6h) is missing a dedicated task. The Plan lists this as a measurable outcome. While T032 mentions 'Performance optimization', it is in the 'Polish' phase and not explicitly linked to SC-005. A task to measure and log total pipeline execution time against the 6-hour limit is missing.

FR-006 (Associational Framing) is missing a dedicated task. The Spec requires the final report to frame findings as associational. T029 generates the report and mentions 'Ensure all findings are framed as associational', but lacks an explicit [FR-006] tag or a specific validation step to verify this framing in the generated text.

SC-002 (Permutation Test p-value) is missing a dedicated task for the 'p < 0.05' check logic. T023 validates SC-002, but the task description focuses on 'Execute/Validate SC-002 compliance' and writing status. The specific logic to calculate the p-value from the permutation distribution and compare it to 0.05 is implied but not explicitly broken out as a distinct verification step in the task list, risking implementation ambiguity.

Task T035 appears twice: once in 'Phase 0: Research & Documentation' and again in 'Phase 2: Foundational'. This duplication creates confusion about the canonical location and dependency chain. One instance should be removed or clearly marked as a reference.

Task T025b (Generate feature importance bar chart) is tagged [US2] but the Plan's Phase 2 output section only lists CSV and JSON artifacts. The image generation is an unverified scope addition. While not strictly 'missing' coverage, the lack of a Plan reference for this artifact makes the task's necessity ambiguous.
